# MDL201 · `unknown-group`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A group that neither mydumper, myloader nor the MySQL client library reads.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | groups |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | §3.6, F16 |
| Proven on real mydumper by | [`f16-product-option-group-mydumper`](../../e2e/scenarios/f16-product-option-group-mydumper.txtar), [`f16-product-option-group-myloader`](../../e2e/scenarios/f16-product-option-group-myloader.txtar) |

## Why

mydumper reads [mydumper], myloader reads [myloader], both read their variable groups ([mydumper_session_variables]) and table sections ([`db`.`table`]); the MySQL client library reads [client]. mydumper reads its per-product option groups ([mydumper_mysql_8_0]) from v0.21.2-2 only, and myloader never reads [myloader_<product>] groups. Any other group is silently ignored, keys included. [mydumper_variables] and [myloader_variables] were renamed [*_session_variables] in v0.14.0-1.

## Example

With mydumper v0.19.3-3:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper_mysql]
no-data=1
[myloader_mysql_8]
threads=2
[myloader_session_variables_mysql]
sql_mode=
[mydumper_oracle]
threads=2
```

```text
1:2-1:16 warning MDL201[unknown-group] [mydumper_mysql] is read by nobody: mydumper v0.19.3-3 does not read per-product option groups (mydumper reads them from v0.21.2-2, myloader never)
  = Every key of this group is ignored.
3:2-3:18 warning MDL201[unknown-group] [myloader_mysql_8] is read by nobody: myloader v0.19.3-3 does not read per-product option groups (mydumper reads them from v0.21.2-2, myloader never)
  = Every key of this group is ignored.
7:2-7:17 warning MDL201[unknown-group] [mydumper_oracle] is read by nobody: the product is not one mydumper knows (clickhouse, dolt, mariadb, mysql, percona, tidb, unknown)
  = Every key of this group is ignored.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL201: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL201` on the line above it.
